# nexus completion

Verbs: get

## Usage

```
nexus completion [flags]
```

## Flags

```
  -h, --help   help for completion
```

## Global flags

```
      --host string   target hosts: configured names, comma-separated, or all (default: NEXUS_HOST, then the default host)
      --verbose       log each request and response status to stderr
```

## Commands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`nexus completion get`](nexus_completion_get.md) | Print the shell completion script |
